test_item:
For non-ECU verification scenarios (e.g., SAM, FOTA, Second Party APKs), the system shall perform revocation checks using Certificate Revocation Lists (CRL) preinstalled in the secure storage of the /odm partition.
(certificate listed in the local revocation list; certificate is rejected)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderAndroidInstrumentalTest.apk is installed
3. The test runner is verified with adb shell pm list instrumentation | grep melcocertprovider (if missing run adb install -r -t CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk)
4. A revocation list "CRL.r0" is preinstalled in the /odm partition
5. Certificate assets are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store
2. Run the baseline verification with the clean DCL in place
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#samCertTestNormalFlow com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
3. Remount the DUT and push dcl_revoked.json to the CertStore as dcl.json
$ adb root && adb remount
$ adb push dcl_revoked.json /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/dcl.json
$ adb shell ls -la /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/
4. Clear the log buffer
$ adb logcat -c
5. Re-run the verification with the revoked DCL in place
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#samCertTestNormalFlow com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
6. Confirm the CertProvider log
$ adb logcat -d | grep -i "CertProvider"
7. Restore the clean baseline DCL and re-run the verification
$ adb push dcl_baseline.json /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/dcl.json
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#samCertTestNormalFlow com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store output lists "CRL.r0"
2. The instrumentation runner reports "OK (1 test)" for samCertTestNormalFlow
3. The adb shell ls -la /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/ output lists "dcl.json"
4. The log buffer is cleared
5. The instrumentation runner reports FAILURES!!! with "expected:<OK> but was:<ERR_CERT_REVOKED>"
6. The adb logcat -d output contains "ERR_CERT_REVOKED"
7. The instrumentation runner reports "OK (1 test)" for samCertTestNormalFlow
